scenarios.narrative_title: The hero — exit now, warranty active
demo_talking_points: Health score 15.6 out of 100 with battery health at 53% — well past the floor where this asset earns money.
Range corrected to 46 km per swap means this driver is losing trips daily; covenant and resale are both at risk.
Warranty claim is still eligible on this Pack3401 — the operator can recover value if they act this week.

scenarios.narrative_title: Second exit — Pack3401 design gap confirmed
demo_talking_points: Health score 26.3 with battery health 76% but range only 69 km — capacity looks okay, the asset still does not.
This is the Pack3401 pattern: design-driven loss that BMS-reported health hides until the operator complains.
Warranty active — bundle the claim with the rest of the Pack3401 cohort for a single conversation with the OEM.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan — Pack3401 with cell-balance window
demo_talking_points: Battery health 91% looks healthy on paper — health score 39 says the trajectory does not.
Range 63 km is below what this route needs; replacement should be scheduled within the next service cycle.
Warranty eligible — claim before the deployment window closes on this pack model.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan — cell balance flagged, range floor breached
demo_talking_points: Range 46 km already at the floor — this battery is failing the route, not just trending toward failure.
Cell balancing is flagged but unlikely to recover the asset given the score trajectory.
Plan replacement; warranty active means OEM picks up the cost if filed promptly.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan with healthy-looking cells — divergence case
demo_talking_points: Battery health near 100% but health score only 51 — the score is reading degradation that capacity has not surfaced yet.
Cell balance flagged — this is where service can buy weeks if scheduled now.
Useful teaching case: capacity and operational health can disagree; trust the composite, not the BMS readout.

scenarios.narrative_title: Investigate — Pack3001 with low capacity, high range
demo_talking_points: Battery health 66% but range still 83 km — this driver is using less than the battery can give.
Investigate before escalating — usage profile may explain the gap without action needed.
Pack3001 pattern: data quality is good, but the cause sits between the battery and the route.

scenarios.narrative_title: Investigate — cell balance, no warranty buffer
demo_talking_points: Health score 32 with cell balance flagged — service intervention is the lever, not replacement.
Warranty not eligible here, so the cost of waiting falls entirely on the operator.
If cell balancing succeeds, this battery moves back into MONITOR; if not, replacement is the next escalation.

scenarios.narrative_title: Investigate — capacity holding, range deficit
demo_talking_points: Battery health 85% but range only 61 km — capacity is fine, the route or driver behaviour is consuming it.
Cell balance flagged — useful preventive service before the deficit becomes a replacement decision.
Warranty eligible adds a deadline to the investigate-or-act decision.

scenarios.narrative_title: False alarm cleared — Pack3401 looks healthy despite BMS flag
demo_talking_points: BMS reports 88% capacity which would normally trigger a service call — platform examines coulomb-corrected SOH and clears it as a measurement artefact.
Range stable at 90 km per swap and DRI 96 confirm the asset is performing on plan.
Warranty has 30 months remaining on this Pack3401 — the operator avoids an unnecessary claim and keeps the battery in service.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — cell balance preventive opportunity
demo_talking_points: Health score 67 with battery health 100% and range 113 km — a healthy GE Pack1201 example.
Cell balance flag is preventive, not corrective — the asset is not at risk this quarter.
Useful as a baseline reference when comparing against the lower-scored Pack1201 cases.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — SG batt running clean in SR
demo_talking_points: Health score 75, battery health 97%, range 95 km — operating well within healthy bands.
SG segment example from the SR cohort; useful for comparing geography effects.
No intervention needed; weekly summary only.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — top SG performer
demo_talking_points: Health score 81, battery health 105% relative to commissioning — this asset is performing above baseline.
Range 100 km holds steady; covenant-grade for NBFC underwriting.
Useful proof point that the SG segment can match or exceed GE under good conditions.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — flagship healthy reference
demo_talking_points: Health score 87, battery health 100%, range 82 km — this is the reference for what a healthy battery looks like.
Used across the platform as the calm-comparison case during demos.
If a customer doubts the platform is conservative, point them at this card.

scenarios.narrative_title: Exit now — independent confirmation
demo_talking_points: Health score 21 with range only 41 km — this battery is failing the daily route already.
GE segment, CU city — a different geography from the Pack3401 hero, same conclusion.
Warranty eligible; act before next billing cycle.

scenarios.narrative_title: Exit now — SG segment failure
demo_talking_points: First SG segment exit case in the demo — health score 37, range 54 km.
Battery health 78% — capacity isn't the worst in the fleet, but the operational picture is.
Warranty active means the SG operator has a recovery option if filed within window.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan — SG, no pack-model attribution
demo_talking_points: Health score 25, battery health 73%, range 60 km — clear replacement case in the SG segment.
No pack-model attribution available, so the case rests on the composite, not the cohort.
Warranty eligible; teach this as the SG operator's version of the Pack3401 conversation.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan — Pack3401, cell balance flagged
demo_talking_points: Health score 27, battery health 85%, range 59 km — replace soon, but cell balance window still open.
Pack3401 cohort confirms this is design-pattern, not driver behaviour.
Warranty eligible — this is the OEM-conversation case, not the operator-fault case.

scenarios.narrative_title: Replace plan — Pack3401 with deep capacity loss
demo_talking_points: Battery health 63% — one of the deeper capacity losses outside the EXIT bucket.
Range 78 km is still respectable; the capacity floor is what forces the replacement decision.
Pack3401 pattern again — bundle with the cohort for the OEM conversation.

scenarios.narrative_title: Investigate — lowest unlocked score, Pack1201
demo_talking_points: Health score 19.6 — among the lowest investigate cases; trajectory is heading toward replace.
Range 78 km masks the underlying capacity loss (battery health 69%) — the operator may not have complained yet.
This is the case the pipeline catches before service desk does.

scenarios.narrative_title: Investigate — Pack3401 with cell balance opportunity
demo_talking_points: Battery health 63%, range 51 km — this is borderline replace, but cell balance flag keeps it in investigate.
Pack3401 again — the same cohort story, different week of the trajectory.
If balancing extends the asset, the warranty claim window stays open longer.

scenarios.narrative_title: Monitor — Pack3001 with range deficit
demo_talking_points: Battery health 66% with range 45 km — capacity is the issue, route can absorb it for now.
Pack3001 cohort has a different signature than Pack3401 — useful contrast.
Warranty active; track weekly and escalate if range drops further.

scenarios.narrative_title: Monitor — Pack3401 with capacity reserve
demo_talking_points: Battery health 91%, range 76 km — comfortably in monitor band despite Pack3401 cohort risk.
Cell balance flag is preventive, not urgent.
Compare with same-pack EXIT cases: cohort risk does not equal individual risk.

scenarios.narrative_title: Monitor — SG with range exceeding spec
demo_talking_points: Range 110 km exceeds the per-pack rated value — the platform handles this with a cohort fallback.
Battery health 100%, no service flags — pure capacity-rich case.
Useful demo for showing how the platform treats range over-performance without breaking trust.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — SG flagship, range 164 km
demo_talking_points: Health score 85, range 164 km — best-performing SG asset in the demo set.
Battery health 103% relative to commissioning — capacity is exceeding the original spec.
Use as the NBFC conversation anchor: this is what an A-grade asset looks like.

scenarios.narrative_title: No action — GE Pack1201 healthy reference
demo_talking_points: Health score 88, battery health 100%, range 137 km — strongest GE Pack1201 in the demo.
Pairs with the lower-scored Pack1201 cases to show within-cohort variation.
DRI score 100 — clean across every signal layer.
